proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal — Independent Board Chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt a policy requiring separate people to hold the Chairman and CEO offices, with the Chairman preferably an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal — Share Retention Until Retirement
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the State of New York, as trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the Compensation Committee to disclose whether it requires named executive officers to retain a significant percentage of equity-based shares until normal retirement age.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal — Report on Tax Payments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a tax transparency report prepared under the GRI Tax Standard, including country-by-country disclosure of payments to governments.
proposals.evidence: For the foregoing reasons, the Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal — Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report detailing direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying policies, payments, recipients and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: For the foregoing reasons, the Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal.
